Powered by universal-ctags and SQLite FTS5, it provides precise symbol search, dependency tracking, and an MCP server. TokToken reduces LLM context token usage by 88-99% by retrieving exact code symbols instead of reading entire files. Zero runtime dependencies.
Entwickler-Werkzeuge & Hilfsmittel.categorization_reason: Ein schneller Codebase-Indexer zur drastischen Reduzierung von LLM-Token-Kosten.
